name: labs/sergey12malyshev__owon-power-supply-driver
title: OWON power supply (owon_ps.OwonPowerSupply)
intro: OWON power supply (owon_ps.OwonPowerSupply), adapted from sergey12malyshev/owon-power-supply-driver. It reads `voltage`, `current`, `power`, `identity` and 1 more; sets `voltage_setpoint`, `current_setpoint`, `voltage_limit`, `current_limit` and 1 more; runs `reset_config` and `output_off`. `reset_config`: reset the instrument to its factory configuration (*RST); it takes no input. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
